description: A timer a shared package sets from a hook another package registered as it loaded, on jest-environment-jsdom with one worker. `auto-cleanup` registers an `afterEach` that unmounts what a test mounted, as @testing-library/react's auto cleanup does; `deferred-destroy`'s unmount destroys the view on a later tick with a timer that reads `window`, as @tiptap/react's does. `unmounts` (the largest, so first) mounts a view and ends with the timer pending; `waits` (a node file, the smallest, so last) waits while it comes due. Jest passes both: the timer is the window's, and `window.close()` cancels it.
